transcript.speaker: antagonist

I shall heed your counsel and embrace this period of rest, for the sake of my strength and the realms. Let the threads settle, and may the lightning within me burn bright once more.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(She finally looks up, her ancient eyes holding a glimmer of sorrow)* Your acceptance honors the weave. But understand... we do not counsel a path to cleansing.
